name: Emilia-Romagna
summary: The regional emblem on white: a green curved line and a red straight bar outlining the region, with green lettering. It has no legal status but is used de facto.
origin: The emblem was adopted in 1989. The white flag was improvised for a display of regional flags at the Quirinale Palace on 4 November 1995 and has been used since.

symbols.name: Emblem
symbols.description: A curved green line and a straight red bar.
symbols.meaning: The Po and nature (curve) and the Via Emilia and human work (straight line).

facts: The straight line evokes the Via Emilia, the Roman road that names half the region.
clues: A white flag with a green curve and a red bar.
Its straight line evokes a Roman road.
It was created for a 1995 display at the Quirinale.
